captions.gbp:
Waiting on insurance to approve your scan? Some health plans need to approve a scan before they'll cover it, and that review can take time. If you'd rather not wait, self-pay patients at Advanced Medical Imaging need no referral and no prior authorization: our physician reviews your request the same day, and same-day scans are often available. Self-pay MRI is $295 without contrast for one body area ($395 with and without contrast), with the radiologist's reading included, and HSA/FSA cards are accepted. Using insurance? That's fine too: we verify your benefits and handle the authorization for you.

Book online at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.
